body:
Audit findings (read-only):

- `app/src/layout/views/layout.tsx:51-146` — shell renders both desktop sidebar and mobile bottom nav in the same DOM; CSS only hides one, so navigation markup is duplicated for every authenticated page.
- `app/src/layout/views/layout.tsx:128-146` — authenticated shell always emits `<main>` plus both nav regions; mobile-only bottom nav has only 4 of 7 destinations, so mobile users lose access to notifications/admin links present in the sidebar.
- `app/src/modules/demands/views/demands.tsx:105-179` — `DemandsTable` (desktop) and `DemandsCards` (mobile) duplicate item rendering and are both shipped in DOM with `desktop-only`/`mobile-only` toggles.
- `app/src/modules/demands/views/demands.tsx:496-511` — calendar page ships a second mobile-only agenda card list in addition to the desktop calendar grid, duplicating item cards.
- `app/src/modules/demands/views/projects.tsx:118-148`, `demands.tsx:300-335`, `demands.tsx:496-511` — demand-card markup is repeated across project, my-tasks, and calendar views with small field variations.
- `app/src/modules/demands/views/item.tsx:163-174` — tabs use `<a role="tab">` with `aria-current`, but no `aria-selected`, `aria-controls`, or associated `role="tabpanel"` containers; tab semantics are incomplete.
- `app/src/layout/views/ui.tsx` `Select` — error state renders a plain `<span class="field-error">` with no `id`, and the `<select>` lacks `aria-describedby`/`aria-invalid`, unlike `Field`/`TextArea`.
- `app/src/modules/demands/views/demands.tsx:106-132` — data table has no `<caption>`, header cells lack explicit `scope="col"`, and 10 columns make the full-HD layout dense.
- `app/src/modules/demands/views/demands.tsx:134` and `projects.tsx` — mobile card containers are anchors wrapping nested interactive elements (badges are spans, but forms/buttons in similar cards elsewhere can create nested interactive issues).
- `app/src/layout/assets/css/app.css:150-152` — `.main` is capped at `max-width: 1280px` and centered, so full-HD monitors leave large unused horizontal space; no wider breakpoint/layout for desktop productivity.
- `app/src/layout/assets/css/app.css:768-777` — responsive branching is binary at 700px, with no intermediate/tablet or full-HD tiers; desktop and mobile markup are both retained and toggled by CSS.
- `app/src/modules/demands/views/demands.tsx:290-335` — `MyPage` renders only mobile-style cards even on desktop, with no table/list density option for developer users.
- `app/src/layout/views/ui.tsx` `Icon` — large inline SVG path map rendered per icon instance; no sprite/symbol reuse, increasing DOM weight on icon-heavy screens.

Overall: the shell is mobile-first with duplicated desktop/mobile navigation and list markup; full-HD space is underused; several interactive components lack complete ARIA wiring.
